intro: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit is a sacred mentor from the realm of Zephras that appears as the Avatar of Saeyleenan in Moonglade. It guides young shen'dorei druids through their spiritual trial so they may embody the windborne feline form of their distant homeland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All adventurers eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.
It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.

I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of an Azerothian cat spirit.
